title: Privately Paid Held Bed Days in a Notice-Billed Medical Assistance Month
content:
Where a resident on Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage has bed-hold days booked for an actual-billed month under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, the days the resident pays privately for the held bed are taken out of that month — they carry no cost. The reservation read is the one the month's booked held days belong to.

**Clause.** The first privately paid held day of an actual-billed month, reading the bed-hold reservation the month's booked held days belong to: where that reservation is a hold whose every held day is the resident's own charge (a private-pay hold or a hold during a Medicare skilled stay), its leave start; where it is a Medicaid reserved bed whose private extension has begun, its private hold start; otherwise none (the first day of the next month), since the program pays the reserved days and patient pay is unchanged for them. The days of the month from that first day through the reservation's last held day (through the month's end where the bed is still held) are taken out. A first day earlier than the month counts from the month's first day.

**Cases.**

1. *A Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold, leave start day 5, last held day 11 of the month.* Every held day is the resident's own charge; days 5 to 11, 7 days, are taken out.
2. *A Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold that began in the previous month and is still held.* Its leave start is before the month, so every day of the month is taken out.
3. *A Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed whose private extension began on day 22 of a 30-day month, bed still held.* Days 22 to 30, 9 days, are taken out.
4. *A Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed with no private extension.* No day is taken out; the program pays the reserved days and patient pay is unchanged for them.
5. *No held day booked for the month.* No day is taken out.
